section.div: Campus-Canteen A TypeScript-based web application for managing canteen operations. Features frontend development with HTML and CSS for a complete ordering and management system.
Student-Performance-Analysis-Dashboard A Streamlit web app that automatically cleans raw student data, visualizes performance trends, and predicts exam marks using Scikit-Learn based on study habits.
DrugGuard-Detection-System An algospeak-resilient Chrome extension with FastAPI backend that uses Naive Bayes and RapidOCR to detect and blur illicit drug content on webpages in real time.
